request.title: Ch09 §9.3 printed: refute three statements (Lemma 9.3.1.5, Def 9.3.1.1, Thm 9.3.3.5(3))
request.body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch09_HardySobolev/Sec3_Printed.lean`: three of its five refutations proved. The other two (#5330, #5331) were not claimed and are untouched.

Closes #5328
Closes #5329
Closes #5332

## What is proved

- `Printed.hardySobolevTranslation_seminorm_le_false` (Lemma 9.3.1.5, (9.3.1.6), p. 421). Counterexample: G = ℝ>0 with the identity modulation and `positiveRealHaar`, a = b = 0, s = 2, and the operator-norm seminorm. The space is nonzero because the indicator of `|log t| ≤ 1` has weighted mass in [2, 4]. At g = 1 the translation is the identity (it is a monoid hom), so the printed bound says `‖id‖ ≤ C · 1 · |log 1| = 0`.
- `Printed.hardySobolevTranslation_preserves_finiteNorm_false` (Definition 9.3.1.1, p. 419). Counterexample: I = [0, ∞), s = 0, and f(t) = B(log t), where B is a smooth bump supported in (−2, −1). f is built as a Bruhat compactly supported function and included into the decay space. Every density `max(e^{2ax}, e^{2bx})` with a, b ≥ 0 is at most 1 on the support, so the norm is at most 1. After translating by g = e³, the function is 1 on `log t ∈ [5/4, 7/4]`. There the weight with a = b = k is at least `e^{2k} ≥ 2k²`, so the supremum is ∞.
- `Printed.truncatedHardySobolevConvolution_diagonal_tendsto_false` (Theorem 9.3.3.5(3), (9.3.3.9), p. 429). Counterexample: G = ℝ>0 with the Dirac mass on the trivial kernel and τ = id (the hypothesis on μ then holds by `map_snd_prod`), and φ the indicator of {1}. The D′-sequence is `U n = {|log t| ≤ 2⁻ⁿ}` (constant 3), and the cutoff is the sharp cutoff of [Λ⁻¹, Λ] with ε = Λ⁻², which satisfies `IsModulatedCutoff` for Λ ≥ 2 with jumps {Λ⁻¹, Λ}. The kernel lives on the diagonal, which is null for the product measure, so every product average is zero and the smoothened diagonal vanishes identically. The printed difference is therefore −2 log Λ, which tends to −∞, not to 0.

All helpers are `private theorem`s placed directly above the theorem they serve. `isBruhatSmooth_logProfile_preservesFiniteNorm` is a copy of the private `isBruhatSmooth_logProfile` from `Sec3.lean`, which this file cannot see. The file also gains `import RiemannMasullo.ForMathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Arithmetic` (for `borelSpace_units_of_continuousInv₀`) and an `open scoped Pointwise in` directly before the last theorem. No statement changed: the output of `scripts/Signatures.lean` for this module is identical before and after (`scripts/signatures.sh --compare` lists nothing).

## Axioms

```
'RiemannMasullo.Printed.hardySobolevTranslation_seminorm_le_false' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'RiemannMasullo.Printed.hardySobolevTranslation_preserves_finiteNorm_false' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'RiemannMasullo.Printed.truncatedHardySobolevConvolution_diagonal_tendsto_false' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
```

The `sorryAx` in the second comes only from the library lemma `bruhatCompactSupport_le_modulatedExponentialDecay` (AppD §3b), which still has an open `sorry` underneath. It is used to put the bump into `ModulatedExponentialDecay`.
